svg.title: Idyllic Clinic architecture
svg.desc: The browser reaches the booking and admin apps on Vercel. They call clinic-api on Cloud Run, which uses Neon Postgres. The admin app streams the staff live feed from clinic-realtime, a read-only Go service on Cloud Run that reads Neon Postgres. The API publishes slot events to Ably after each commit and the patient booking page subscribes. The browser gets a reCAPTCHA token, and the booking app verifies it with reCAPTCHA Enterprise using a federated access token, and calls Resend. CircleCI pushes images to Artifact Registry, runs the clinic-migrate job and deploys. Secret Manager supplies the API and the migration job.
